title: Pricing Office Calculation Sheet: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs Club Price of a Cash Fill
content:
The Kestrel Rx Savings Club price of a cash fill under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is worked out as follows.

**Inputs.** The usual and customary price of the fill is the patient pay that the fill ledger shows on the patient's latest cash fill, which is the fill being priced, and its days supply is the days supply dispensed on that fill. Whether the fill is a generic or a brand is read from the product dispensed on that same fill.

**Generic fill.** The club price of a generic fill is the usual and customary price less the program's generic discount percentage, rounded to the cent half up.

**Brand fill.** A brand fill is priced at the usual and customary price less the program's brand discount percentage, rounded to the cent half up.

**Limits.** The club price is never below the program's minimum cash price and never above the usual and customary price. The two limits are applied last, to the rounded price: the price is held to no more than the usual and customary price, and a price below the minimum cash price is raised to the minimum cash price.

The generic discount percentage, the brand discount percentage and the minimum cash price are the program's figures on the cash discount price schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual figures: generic 25%, brand 15%, minimum $3.00)

| Fill | Usual and customary price | Working | Club price |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generic | $58.40 | 58.40 less 25 percent of it is 43.80 | $43.80 |
| Brand | $123.00 | 123.00 less 15 percent of it is 104.55 | $104.55 |
| Generic | $3.60 | 3.60 less 25 percent of it is 2.70, below the minimum | $3.00 |

## Judgement points

- The fill being priced is the latest cash fill on the fill ledger; an insurance-billed fill is not the fill priced here.
- The generic or brand character of the fill decides which discount percentage is taken.
